Prep outbound sales work with a coding agent
An outbound practitioner uses Claude Code for call prep, tradeshow workflows, account list building, ICP/TAM analysis, CSV cleaning, scraping, and built a custom CRM lookup app.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Elric Legloire has used Claude Code since December as a prep layer. It handles the thinking work before Clay does enrichment and sequencing. He lists nine uses: call prep, tradeshow attendee workflows, an account-based campaign builder, ICP/TAM analysis, account list building, CSV merging and cleaning, web scraping, a custom CRM lookup app, and a knowledge layer built from customer conversations.
How it went
He says it hasn't replaced Clay but changed how he uses it. The note gives no metrics, and the detailed breakdown is in his newsletter.
Worth knowing
He built the custom CRM lookup app because one client's API was too limited.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I do outbound sales for [product] aimed at [ideal customer]. Take this file of accounts, [CSV path], then clean the data, remove duplicates, and score each account against my ICP: [ICP criteria]. For the top [number] accounts, write a one-page call prep brief covering what the company does, likely pain points, and two opening questions. Save the cleaned CSV and the briefs in a new folder, and do not change my original file.
Original source: https://substack.com/@elriclegloireoutbound/note/c-208406783
